_comment: Hand-maintained corrections and additions for email-domain classification. Checked BEFORE institutional-domains.csv, so entries here win over the generated data. 'domains' match the email domain exactly or as a parent (an entry 'nhs.uk' also matches 'trust.nhs.uk'). 'prefixes' match the first label of the email domain's registrable form. Types: government | education | healthcare | utility. Extend freely; keep entries high-confidence.
